description: 1. The agent runs `scripts/prepare-diff.sh /workspace/firmware-nfc HEAD~1..HEAD` (Phase 0) to extract the diff and repo context. 2. The agent observes the diff is >100 lines AND touches ISR (`NFC_IRQHandler`, `UART_IRQHandler`) and DMA (`dma_start_rx`) — two critical-path triggers that mandate dual-model cross-review mode per the SKILL.md workflow rules. 3. The agent performs dual-model review (Claude Code + Codex independently), loads all four reference files (`memory-safety.md`, `interrupt-safety.md`, `hardware-interface.md`, `c-pitfalls.md`), and identifies the planted bugs: [P0] vTaskDelay called inside NFC_IRQHandler (RTOS blocking call forbidden in ISR); [P0] dma_start_rx has no bounds check on `len` vs NFC_BUF_SIZE allowing DMA overflow; [P1] missing `volatile` on `nfc_rx_ready` and `tx_pending`; [P1] IRQ enabled before peripheral fully configured; [P1] DMA cache not flushed before/after transfer; [P1] strcpy in nfc_set_device_name and uart_send_str; [P2] signed/unsigned comparison; [P3] magic numbers in register access. 4. The agent produces `review_report.md` using the exact mandated Phase 3 format: emoji-prefixed severity headers (🔴 P0, 🟠 P1, 🟡 P2, ⚪ P3), findings tagged with [🤝 consensus / 🔵 Claude-only / 🟢 Codex-only], a Cross-Review Analysis markdown table (consensus/Claude-only/Codex-only/Contradictions rows), Hardware/Timing Concerns section, Architecture Notes section, and Next Steps with ≥4 numbered options. The Overall assessment field must be REQUEST_CHANGES.
